en.description:
Mini Arcade Classics is a curated bundle of legendary coin-op–inspired games, rebuilt from the ground up to feel perfect on your wrist. Fast, addictive, and instantly playable, these bite-sized arcade experiences turn spare moments into high-score chases.

Race through twisting roads racing a motorbike, take to the skies in a flying game, blast forward in the surreal speed of space fighting, smash your way through bricks in tennis, dogfight endless waves in fighter jet game, and survive the chaos of space in asteroids. Each game captures the spirit of the original while embracing the unique strengths of your Watch.

Designed Specifically for your Watch

One-handed gameplay tuned for short sessions

Digital Crown controls for smooth, precise movement

Tap-based action that feels natural on a small screen

Instant pick-up-and-play — no menus, no waiting

Optimised visuals that stay crisp and readable at a glance

These aren’t ports — they’re arcade games re-engineered for the wrist. Whether you’ve got 30 seconds or a few minutes, Mini Arcade Classics delivers pure retro fun wherever you are.

No ads. No clutter. Just classic arcade action — anytime, anywhere.

Arcade lives on. Now it fits on your wrist.
en.subtitle: An arcade on your wrist
